title: Rate limits | Quillstream API v3 Reference
description: Quillstream API v3 enforces rate limits per workspace. Starter: 120 requests per minute. Team: 400 requests per minute. Business: 1,200 requests per minute. Enterprise: custom limits.

title: Rate limits (API v2, deprecated) | Quillstream Docs
description: This page documents the deprecated v2 API. v2 rate limits: Starter 60 requests per minute, Team 200 requests per minute, Business 600 requests per minute.

title: Business plan rate limit is 900 rpm? - Quillstream Community
description: We upgraded to Business and our integration still gets 429s at around 900 requests per minute. Is the Business rate limit 900?

title: Pricing - Quillstream
description: Starter $0, Team $19 per seat/month, Business $49 per seat/month with SSO, audit logs and higher API limits. Enterprise: contact sales.

title: API limits | Quillpad Developer Docs
description: Quillpad API rate limits: Free 30 requests per minute, Pro 100 requests per minute, Business 300 requests per minute.

title: Quillstream review 2025: a capable workflow API
description: Quillstream's API is generous: even the Business plan allows 600 requests a minute, which should cover most integrations.
